text.en:
English has one “the”. German has three.
Das ist der Schlüssel. = This is the key.
Das ist means “this is”. Schlüssel means “key”.
Das ist die Tasche. = This is the bag.
Das ist das Handy. = This is the cell phone.
Tasche means “bag”. Handy means “cell phone”.
The “the” changed: der, die, das.

Each German thing keeps its own “the”.
You cannot guess it, so learn the pair.
der Schlüssel = the key
die Tasche = the bag
das Handy = the cell phone
For more than one, it is always die.
Das sind die Schlüssel. = These are the keys.
Sind means “are”.

You will see a sentence in English.
Build it in German, word by word.
Watch the “the”: der, die or das?
Der Stuhl ist kaputt. = The chair is broken.
Stuhl means “chair”. Kaputt means “broken”.
Only one “the” fits each thing.
